message: The other day, I was cooking up a storm in the kitchen when I heard that familiar beep of the smoke alarm. Instead of panicking like I usually do, I smiled because I had finally remembered to check the batteries last weekend! It was such a small win, but it felt great to be the prepared one for once. After that, I decided it was time to go over our family escape plan again—better safe than sorry, right? Do you have a plan in place for your home?
